description: This C# source file defines the class RedisKeyManagementOptionsSetup, which configures Redis-based data protection key management for OrchardCore. It sets up Redis keys, manages key migration during upgrades, and checks Redis persistence settings.

classes.name: RedisKeyManagementOptionsSetup
classes.description: A class that implements IConfigureOptions to set up Redis-based key management options for data protection in OrchardCore.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures the KeyManagementOptions to use Redis for storing data protection keys, including handling key migration and logging warnings.

methods.name: ChangeXmlRepositoryRedisKey
methods.description: Handles migration of Redis keys for data protection, copying old keys to new format if necessary, with logging.

methods.name: CheckRedisPersistenceEnabled
methods.description: Checks if Redis persistence (AOF or RDB) is enabled, considering admin command permissions and server info.
